method: Reconstruct four candidate forecasts (local, neighbor, and each with the prior market contrarian gate) at each signal date. From each candidate's calls in the past 24 months whose outcomes finished strictly before this signal, select the highest historical hit rate if at least 50%, 60 calls, nine signal months and ten symbols. Ties use fixed candidate order. Emit only when the selected candidate itself calls. Outcomes of simultaneously pending forecasts never enter selection. Compare all candidates on identical eligible observations, not necessarily identical selected calls. Ties in prices are misses.
limitations: Selector and candidates follow repeated inspection of the same years. This is exploratory, not an untouched holdout or prospective test; bootstrap intervals omit research selection.
Monthly windows overlap, assets share shocks and selection rates are not calibrated probabilities. Selected current listings omit many delisted assets; local-history eligibility restricts coverage.
Yahoo crypto differs from Binance. No fees, taxes, dividends, slippage or executable same-close entry modeled. No production deployment.
